epoch_rules: Epoch IDs contiguous from0; reset cycles strictly increase; nonfinal stop_kind RESET and stop_cycle equals next epoch reset_cycle; final stop_kind END with stop_cycle the maximum observation horizon
frames is a complete explicit list, sorted by cycle and contiguous frame_id, each at reset_cycle..stop_cycle inclusive
A frame due at RESET stop_cycle remains an old-epoch obligation and is included; default order FRAME then due CONSUME then RESET; no runtime reset exemption
next_frame is the first independently scheduled frame after the listed frames, may be outside capture; its cycle is strictly greater than stop_cycle
Every adjacent planned frame including sentinel has gap833 or834; this is sanity checking only, not a physical frequency proof
Every request cycle equals an explicitly listed frame; presentation_due is its next planned frame; service_due=min(request_cycle+833,presentation_due)
Actual END may be earlier than final maximum stop_cycle only when every planned request has been observed and every transaction is terminal; all planned frames <=actual END must already be observed
No derivation of epoch/frame schedule or maximum observation horizon from actual trace; M2 must bind independent plan bytes and provenance before runtime
